group.title: Fixing a missing receipt
group.passage:
F1: My expense claim was returned because a taxi receipt is missing. I uploaded a photograph from my phone, so I'm not sure what happened.
M1: The new system accepts image files, but each upload must be under five megabytes. Did you see a confirmation message?
F1: I don't remember one. The photograph was very large because I used the highest camera setting.
M1: That probably explains it. Resize the image and upload it again. You don't need to enter the other expenses a second time.
F1: Will I still receive reimbursement this month?
M1: Yes, provided your manager approves the corrected claim by tomorrow afternoon. I'll send her a reminder once the receipt appears.
group.passageZh:
女：我的費用申請因缺計程車收據被退回。我用手機上傳了照片，不知道怎麼了。
男：新系統收圖片檔，但每個上傳檔案必須小於 5 MB。有看到確認訊息嗎？
女：不記得。因為用了相機最高畫質，照片很大。
男：大概就是原因。縮小再上傳，不必重新輸入其他費用。
女：這個月還能收到報銷款嗎？
男：可以，只要主管最晚在明天下午核准更正後的申請。收據出現後我會提醒她。
